answer: Every agent signs jobs with a session key that expires after a set count, and the rotation request carries the hashes of the jobs it covered, which an auditor matches against the grove of settled receipts before a new key is issued. A failed audit slashes that key and leaves no relic of earlier standing, so a farm has to keep producing real work to keep rotating. Quorum votes must span unrelated subnetworks, closing the oasis where one operator's clones approve each other. A thousand clones cannot fake a route through five separate networks.
